create.name: Hayagriva Buddhist Centre
create.bio:
Hayagriva Buddhist Centre is a Gelug Tibetan Buddhist centre in Kensington, an inner suburb of Perth in Western Australia, and part of the FPMT network founded by Lama Thubten Yeshe and Lama Zopa Rinpoche. It has run for more than thirty years as a volunteer-led, non-profit association. Its teacher today is Venerable Drolkar, an Australian nun who studied with Lama Zopa Rinpoche for over three decades and has long worked within FPMT.

Each Sunday the centre holds a guided meditation followed by a drop-in Discovering Buddhism class, in which Venerable Drolkar works through FPMT's lam-rim modules one by one, most recently the wisdom of emptiness, with time for questions and no need to have attended earlier sessions. A Tuesday morning meditation, Tara pujas and occasional practice workshops round out the week, and everything is offered by donation so that cost keeps no one away. Members help meet running costs and receive library access, shop discounts and a vote at the annual meeting, and recordings of past teachings are shared on its website.

courses.title: Discovering Buddhism
courses.description: A weekly Sunday class with Venerable Drolkar that takes FPMT's lam-rim course one module at a time, each lasting about four to eight weeks. Newcomers can join at any session, and there is plenty of room for questions.

courses.title: Sunday Meditation
courses.description: A guided group meditation at the Kensington centre at ten o'clock every Sunday morning, open to all.

courses.title: Tuesday Morning Meditation
courses.description: A weekly midweek meditation session held at the centre on Tuesday mornings.

courses.title: Membership
courses.description: Monthly or annual membership that keeps the volunteer-run centre open, with lower suggested donations at events, library use, shop discounts and voting rights.
courses.price: Individual: $15 monthly or $155 annually; Concession: $10 monthly or $105 annually; Family: $20 monthly or $230 annually

free_resources.title: Current and Past Recordings
free_resources.description: Links to recordings of teachings given at the centre over its thirty-plus years, current and historical, together with useful links to FPMT and the Lama Yeshe Wisdom Archive.
